message:
I remember the last time we had a power outage; it felt like the universe decided to throw a little family reunion right in our living room! As the lights flickered out, I quickly grabbed my trusty flashlight and a power bank for my phone, knowing that staying connected was key. 

In the midst of the darkness, our family group chat lit up with the funniest memes and updates. My daughter sent a pic of her dog looking confused by the lack of lights, while my son was busy figuring out how to cook dinner on the grill. 

It made me realize that even in a blackout, technology can keep us laughing and connected. So, when the lights go out, don’t forget to check in with your loved ones—who knows, it might turn into a fun little adventure! 

What’s your favorite way to stay connected during a power outage?
